composition: Tuff cliff town stacked on a sheer canyon edge with fortress crest · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The town is seen from across the gorge, its stone houses lined along the cliff edge across the center and right of the frame. The fortress crowns the highest point at the top-right, with the houses below it built of the same golden tuff. The sheer cliff face drops away beneath them, and a wooded valley fills the left of the view. The modelled scenario is 23 September 2026 at 12:20 Europe/Rome: bright midday sun.
